newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ERIKSSON FINALLY TURNS DOWN BLACKBURN JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ERIKSSON FINALLY TURNS DOWN BLACKBURN JOB.

text.p: Swedish coach Sven Goran Eriksson has pulled out of his contract to join Blackburn at the end of the season, the English premier league club said on Friday.
Blackburn chairman Robert Coar said in a statement: "We have now received written notice from Sven Goran Eriksson advising that he will not be joining Blackburn Rovers as manager this summer.
"We are obviously disappointed with this turn of events and the board will be discussing the matter further over the weekend. A further statement will be made early next week."

Since initially agreeing to move to Blackburn, Eriksson, currently in charge at Sampdoria, has been linked with a move to Lazio as replacement for Czech coach Zdenek Zeman, a switch that would see him remaining in Italy.
Blackburn announced in December they had signed Eriksson to replace their caretaker coach Tony Parkes at the end of the season. Parkes succeeded Ray Harford who resigned last October.
It was reported that Eriksson had signed a three-year contract with Blackburn worth more than one million pounds ($1.6 million).
